note: Replay goldens of std-lolo-swift (std-lolo-source with the Swift vocabulary, requiresTypes). Each case feeds the lowered program (orb lower, field orb) together with the checker's types map (program/read inspect, keyed by ir-path) as the LOLO_INSPECTED answer (program/read has no substrate host in goldens, G-STD-262), with the installed operator names seeded in the entity and typed set. 112 of 190 operators of the pure modules (core, str, array, object, math, validate, json, bit) have a Swift template, the forms included. The 78 with none render as a warning and a generic stub that stops when run: array/cosine, array/groupBy, array/insert, array/nearest, array/partition, array/pmap, array/preduce, array/remove, array/removeItem, array/shuffle, bit/and, bit/not, bit/or, bit/rotl, bit/rotr, bit/shl, bit/shr, bit/xor, json/nodes, json/parse, json/stringify, json/valid, math/acos, math/approach, math/asin, math/deg-rad, math/lerp, math/map, math/rad-deg, math/random, math/randomInt, math/wrap, object/clone, object/deepClone, object/deepMerge, object/entries, object/equals, object/filter, object/fromEntries, object/keys, object/mapKeys, object/mapValues, object/values, path, quasiquote, quote, row/matches, str/camelCase, str/collate, str/collate-key, str/decode-uri-component, str/encode-uri-component, str/kebabCase, str/replace-pattern, str/snakeCase, str/template, str/titleCase, str/to-number, str/uri-component-valid, tree/fold, tree/index, unquote, validate/array, validate/boolean, validate/check, validate/creditCard, validate/date, validate/email, validate/noneOf, validate/number, validate/object, validate/pattern, validate/phone, validate/string, validate/url, validate/uuid, value/depth, value/key. An operator called with an arity its templates do not cover (array/sum, avg, max, min, sort with a key; array/sort with an order) is the same stub. The expected texts compile with swiftc against the Entities.swift and Events.swift of orb compile -s ios and give the kernel's answers on the course examples; the cases whose emit lists several payload fields rely on payloadFieldOrder sorted, the order the shell declares them in.
